name: Process
description: Inspect session-owned background jobs, logs, stop, or close unknown monitoring.

function.name: process
function.description: Manage background jobs started in this conversation. list/status/log are reads. kill stops only this job. close-monitoring requires explicit user intent and confirm=true; it does not stop the process.

id.description: Canonical job ID, required except for list.

tail.description: Maximum retained tail characters for log (default 65536, capped at 1 MiB).

cursor.description: Last observed log cursor; unchanged logs return empty text.

confirm.description: Explicit user confirmation to close Unknown monitoring; the process may still run.
